_about: Anchor sources for the AirBorder report. The bibliography may hold only these keys: at most max_anchor_papers authoritative peer-reviewed conference papers, plus the project's own materials (interview/survey records, evaluation instruments, verification records) that cannot be reproduced in full in the report. Appendix-only sources are not cited. Checked by Scripts/reporting/check_citations.py. Set approved to true once the authors confirm the anchors. Anchors are chosen by the authors from Report/ANCHOR-CANDIDATES.md.

project_materials.what: Deployed AirBorder travel survey (instrument used for the interviews and evaluation plan).
Preliminary survey and interview response analysis (R1, R2).
Synthetic scenario audit and verification record (technical validation evidence).
